thread:
kai: starting a thread to land pilot gating rules for dedicated burst features. we need a compact, testable set of launch criteria and a small scope so ops isn't overloaded.

nina: +1. propose two parallel pilots: automated 'soft-hold' (auto-convert off by default) and manual 'burst-ticket' (CS approvals). different risk profiles.

raj: for both pilots we should set hard budget and conversion caps. my suggested defaults:
- pool-level soft_hold cap: 12%
- per-tenant soft_hold cap: 8% of their committed quota
- auto-convert threshold: sustained util > 65% for 15 minutes
- convert opt-in default: OFF

ops-lee: add emergency controls: feature flag per-pool, global kill switch, and an alert "burst_pool_pressure" when soft_hold_active_pct > 10% for > 8m. runbook: reduce cap -> disable new holds -> consider emergency preempt.

amy_cs: CS needs billing examples and a one-click promo in Console for pilot customers. pilot acceptance criteria: clear billing preview, CS approval workflow for manual tickets, and 3 customers onboarded with defined SLOs.

kai: metrics we must surface before GA:
- soft_hold.requests, soft_hold.active, soft_hold.converted, soft_hold.rejected
- time_to_approval for manual tickets
- pool_pressure and tail latency by tenant

nina: safety tests: simulator replay with 200 tenants for 2 weeks, ensure <2% tail latency regression and <5% GPU-hour delta at 25% conversion. raj will run.

raj: action: simulator job scheduled, baseline traffic loaded. will report results in 3 days.

ops-lee: action: I'll add feature flag and alerts, and draft runbook changes.

amy_cs: action: I'll pick pilot customers and prepare Console copy.

kai: timeline: 3 sprints to pilot: scheduler hooks + API (sprint 1), console + metrics + alerts (sprint 2), pilot ops + docs + legal (sprint 3). gate to GA after meeting cost and latency gates.

deploy-bot: CI: test coverage for scheduler hooks added in branch "burst-pilot-gating". Build 507 green. :white_check_mark:

kai: check: any objections to scope?

nina: none, prefer a conservative default for caps.

raj: +1 pending simulator pass.

ops-lee: +1 with kill-switch requirement.

amy_cs: +1, will finalize pilot cohort.
